launch_condition: Only methods that independently pass both +2.0 percentage point SR and SPL gates on the frozen 256-episode factorial screen are scaled; scale every passing method.

training.candidate_checkpoints: new matched training for each passing method and each seed

evaluation.control_reuse_condition: Reuse prior control inference only when its model path, checkpoint step, decode seed, manifest, evaluator source, 1839 unique episodes, and zero inference errors are verified; evaluate candidates with the same evaluator and settings.
evaluation.required_pairing: candidate versus same-seed control on the same 1839 episode IDs
report: per-seed paired SR and SPL percentage-point differences
three-seed mean and sample standard deviation
all per-episode compact metrics and exact coverage audit

interpretation_limit: Val-unseen was already used during earlier method development, so this is a larger development replication, not a clean unseen-scene confirmation. Simulator geodesic progress remains privileged training feedback.
